optimizedDescription.value: Builds delivery-neutral implementation reviews from Core tracking, one graph-health snapshot, and batched symbol resolution.

optimizedContext.value:
# SDK Build Implementation Review

## Rules

- `buildImplementationReview(ctx, input)`: fetch raw review from `ctx.kernel.changes.getImplementationReview`; open graph via `withOpenGraphProvider`; obtain canonical graph health once; batch-resolve all symbol links through `ResolveSymbolReference` under one provider lifecycle. Never open provider or scan full graph per link.
- SDK MUST NOT parse source syntax, duplicate symbol matching, or format presentation. Core owns stored tracking; Code Graph owns resolution.
- Preserve every stored spec, file, symbol value unchanged. Symbol links add status, reason code, graph health/coverage, canonical logical target, declarations, candidates, public/local binding provenance, ordered resolution path when available.
- File links remain valid without symbol resolution. MUST NOT mutate active manifests, confirmed links, archived sidecars.
- Readable non-current/incomplete graph => per-link `unresolved`. Provider availability, generation, lifecycle failures preventing safe reads => standard SDK infrastructure error; never rewrite as missing links.
- All implementation-review hosts, including change implementation commands and change status enrichment, consume same projection. No independent same-file, rightmost-segment, workspace-name fallbacks.

## Constraints

- Structured data only.
- Core and Code Graph public APIs only.
- Resolution diagnostics do not block verification or archive in this change.
